scripts.db:export: node -e "const Dexie = require('dexie'); const exportDB = require('dexie-export-import'); const db = new Dexie('expenseManagementDB'); db.version(1).stores({ wallets: '++id, name, type, currency', categories: '++id, name, type', expenses: '++id, wallet_id, date, category, type', budgets: '++id, category_name, month_year', transfers: '++id, source_wallet_id, destination_wallet_id, created_at', settings: 'id', savings_goals: '++id, name, target_date, linked_wallet_id', currencies: '++id, code, isDefault' }); db.open().then(() => exportDB(db, { pretty: true, format: 'json' }).then(blob => { require('fs').writeFileSync('db-export.json', blob); console.log('Database exported to db-export.json'); })).catch(err => { console.error('Export failed:', err); })"
scripts.db:import: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const Dexie = require('dexie'); const importDB = require('dexie-export-import'); const db = new Dexie('expenseManagementDB'); db.version(1).stores({ wallets: '++id, name, type, currency', categories: '++id, name, type', expenses: '++id, wallet_id, date, category, type', budgets: '++id, category_name, month_year', transfers: '++id, source_wallet_id, destination_wallet_id, created_at', settings: 'id', savings_goals: '++id, name, target_date, linked_wallet_id', currencies: '++id, code, isDefault' }); db.open().then(() => importDB(fs.readFileSync('db-export.json', 'utf8'), { overwriteValues: true }).then(() => { console.log('Database imported successfully'); })).catch(err => { console.error('Import failed:', err); })"
